stories.headline: US announces new tariffs on 14 trading partners
stories.summary: The US has proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU, aimed at countering trade practices deemed unfair or burdensome to US commerce. China called the levies 'political manipulation' and baseless, while Brazil said it will not bend to the 'threat'. Proposed rates reported include 18% for Bangladesh, Cambodia and Thailand, and 20% for China and Vietnam, subject to trade deals.

stories.headline: Cairo fuel tanker crash kills at least 31
stories.summary: A fuel tanker crash on a ring road surrounding Cairo ignited a huge fire on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people according to Egyptian authorities. At least 21 others were injured, and cars and motorcycles were left charred.

stories.headline: Israeli judges urge dropping most serious Netanyahu charges
stories.summary: Israeli judges have recommended dropping most of the serious charges against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, saying there was little chance of conviction in one of three cases. Netanyahu said his trial should end as a result.

stories.headline: Colombia supermarket siege ends with all hostages freed
stories.summary: Colombian police stormed a supermarket in the tourist city of Cartagena, ending a daylong siege in which all hostages were freed. One man described as a hostage-taker was killed, and it is unclear whether he may have been a hostage. President Abelardo de la Espriella was at the scene and later confronted the arrested men.

stories.headline: Six killed in plane crash off Mississippi coast
stories.summary: Six people, including children, were killed in a plane crash off the Mississippi coast. US authorities are investigating the cause, and the victims were members of the Stokes and Knox families.

stories.headline: Sri Lankan asylum seeker dies after UK removal to Eswatini
stories.summary: A Sri Lankan asylum seeker, Kishanth Peramalya, was sent by the UK to Eswatini after being denied entry over sexual assault convictions, and killed himself there. He had no connections to the southern African country.

stories.headline: Swiss tourist killed by elephants in Cameroon
stories.summary: A Swiss tourist was killed and British and American tourists were injured when a hiking group encountered a herd of elephants near Mount Cameroon national park. The victim was reportedly London-based insurance executive Alain Throo, and the group had six tourists.

stories.headline: US stocks fall as AI fears intensify
stories.summary: US stocks fell further in early trading as fears over AI intensified, with all three main indexes down and the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%. Later reports said the AI trade was rebounding ahead of Thanksgiving after a week of whipsawing.

stories.headline: Poundland collapses into administration
stories.summary: Poundland has fallen into administration after its owners failed to find a buyer, putting between 10,000 and 11,000 jobs at risk. The budget chain is expected to be broken up, with store closures, after its US owner rejected at least two last-ditch bids.

stories.headline: Energy bills to rise 26% from January
stories.summary: Ofgem's energy price cap is rising, lifting a typical household's annual bill from £1,723 to £2,166 if sustained for a year, after gas prices surged. The Bank of England has said UK food inflation could reach 5% next year, partly due to the energy price cap rise.

stories.headline: Nvidia faces rating warning and export halt
stories.summary: S&P Global Ratings warned Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch over 'rising' management and governance risk. Nvidia has also halted chip shipments to south-east Asia as the US steps up export controls to stop Chinese access to AI computing power.

stories.headline: US approves SpaceX plan for a million data satellites
stories.summary: US regulators approved a plan from SpaceX for a constellation of up to a million satellites to act as orbital data centres, known as Starmind. Deployment of 100,000 is required no later than November 2035, according to the FCC approval.

stories.headline: South Korea central bank raises rates
stories.summary: The Bank of Korea raised its key rate by 0.25 percentage points to 3.25%, resuming increases after a pause in October. It also raised its GDP growth forecast, amid booming exports of AI chips.

stories.headline: Aston Villa lose to Galatasaray in Champions League
stories.summary: Aston Villa were beaten by a late Deniz Gul winner for Galatasaray, their second successive Champions League defeat. A Villa fan described it as a learning curve.

stories.headline: Man Utd and Sporting draw 2-2 in chaotic game
stories.summary: Manchester United drew 2-2 with Sporting in Lisbon in an incident-packed Champions League match. Goalkeeper Senne Lammens made errors, and Mauricio Pochettino said United were punished by officials' decisions.

stories.headline: Liverpool beat Club Brugge with Isak double
stories.summary: Liverpool beat Club Brugge with goals from Alexander Isak, who scored twice, and Florian Wirtz. Isak's two goals take his season tally to 10.

stories.headline: Barcelona beat Sabah 4-1; Bayern lose to Lille
stories.summary: Barcelona beat Sabah 4-1 with Anthony Gordon scoring twice. Bayern Munich suffered their first Champions League defeat, losing to Lille after a Aleksander Pavlovic own goal among two late goals in three minutes.

stories.headline: England face All Blacks with five changes
stories.summary: England made five changes for their rematch with New Zealand on Saturday, with Exeter back row Greg Fisilau making his first start. Fin Smith has become one of England's most prolific ball carriers.

stories.headline: Australia v Ireland in Nations Championship
stories.summary: Kurtley Beale, 37, was named on the Wallabies bench for the season-ending Nations Championship clash with Ireland, ending a five-year exile, while Allan Alaalatoa joins the 100 club. Ireland's Jacob Stockdale returns for the Friday fifth-place play-off against Australia.

stories.headline: Cricket: Clayton and Handscomb feature in Sheffield Shield
